en: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
orig: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
plotEn:
Events depicted take place a few months after Button House owners Alison and Mike have moved away. The ghosts of Button House are adjusting to life without them, having become bored after the construction work on the planned golf course was delayed due to outside issues. Their only source of excitement are postcards from Alison and Mike. The situation becomes further enlivened when a group of eco protesters hope to block the construction of the planned hotel, leaving the ghosts wishing to find a way to contact Alison to get aid.
An opportunity arises when a group of teenagers come to Button House at night to perform a seance.  Sammy, one of the teens, has experience with ghosts because her grandmother is a medium. Based on Sammy's tales, Jack, a teen, invites one of the ghosts to communicate through him, which allows Julian to possess Jack's body while forcing Jack's spirit out. The other ghosts and teens can only watch in confusion as Julian-in-Jack runs off, leaving Button House and grounds  for the first time since his death. 
While Julian makes his way to Alison through a world changed significantly since his death, Jack's spirit is revealed to have remained at Button House. Pat and Kitty try to help him adjust to his new state, the Captain, Fanny and Robin spy on the protesters, with Robin becoming interested in one of them, a woman named Janine.
